# go-modern-time-until

**Since:** Go 1.8

## Summary

Use time.Until(deadline) instead of deadline.Sub(time.Now()).

## Details

time.Until is the standard spelling for remaining time before a deadline.
It is equivalent to deadline.Sub(time.Now()) but reads in the direction the caller cares about.

## Examples

### Before

```go
remaining := deadline.Sub(time.Now())
```

### After

```go
remaining := time.Until(deadline)
```
